title: Wolf Tooth Raw Silver + Espresso + Colored End Caps
content:
Wolf Tooth’s award-winning and fully rebuildable CTRL, ALT, DEL, and Shift clipless pedals now come in a raw silver finish along with an espresso brown, and if you’d like to add some color to your existing pedals, the Minnesota-based manufacturer just released colored end caps…

The Wolf Tooth Clipless Pedals you know and love are now available in Raw Silver and Espresso. These pedals are designed for unparalleled control, power transfer, and durability for mountain, gravel, and road bikes. Add to that our adjustable q-factor, massive pedal-to-shoe contact, lightweight design, and rebuild kits readily available, and you’ve got yourself a real game changer.

Compatible with original ALT and DEL premium and MKØ pedals, you can now mix and match your pedal and end cap color to match your bike’s paint, accessory color, or even your favorite socks.

Check it all out at Wolf Tooth.
